locking.description: Provisions bucket from the `-lock` BucketClass (with object lock enabled).

storagePool.description: Selects a specific BucketClass by storage pool name.

ui.description: Deploys the web UI (s3manager) with its Service and its Ingress or HTTPRoute at `<bucket>.<tenant host>`. Set to `false` to run the bucket without them.

readonly.description: Whether the user has read-only access.

schedulingClass.description: Name of a SchedulingClass CR (cluster-scoped, group cozystack.io) applied to this application's workloads in place of the tenant's. Must be the tenant's own class or one listed in the tenant's `allowedSchedulingClasses`; any other value is refused. Empty means inherit from the tenant.
